query:
SELECT DISTINCT d.id, d.name, d.environment,
                   d.type_organisation || '/' || d.type_name || '@' || d.type_version
                       AS "destination_type!"
            FROM destinations d
            LEFT JOIN environments e ON d.environment_id = e.id
            WHERE d.organisation = $3
              AND CASE WHEN $4::bool
                       THEN d.name = ANY($1)
                       ELSE e.name = ANY($2)
                  END
